body.independence_note: Live Ghidra resolves 0x0059cb10 to its own entry point EditorAnimWorld_PlayAnimation with a distinct body range 0x0059cb10..0x0059cb7c, separate from GetCreatureController (ends 0x0059cb01) and SetTargetAngle (starts 0x0059cea0).
mechanics: Spill argument 1 to the key slot before the three pushes so the lower-bound key pointer stays valid.
Read the map gate this+0x38; when zero skip the lookup entirely and take the null path. The cursor is a stack local written through a valid out pointer.
Compare the cursor against the end sentinel this+0x0c; an end result yields a null controller.
Then require this+0x3c to be non-zero, the controller to be non-null, and controller+0x08 to be non-null; any zero returns with no side effect.
Call the creature vtable slot +4 (offset 0x04) with (animationID, 0) via MOV EDX,[EAX+0x4]; CALL EDX.

Then call the distinct publication port for 0x007cd950 with (controller, animationID). That routine is a three-instruction body that stores the animation id at controller+0x1c; it is NOT the ground update helper 0x0059b390, which an earlier revision wrongly reused for it.
Epilogue is POP EDI/ESI/ECX, RET 0x8; the return register is unused.

publication_slot.evidence: 0x007cd950 decompiles to *(undefined4 *)(param_1 + 0x1c) = param_2 and its three-instruction listing is MOV EAX,[ESP+0x4]; MOV dword ptr [ECX+0x1c],EAX; RET 0x4

evidence.observation: Live entry EditorAnimWorld_PlayAnimation spans 0x0059cb10..0x0059cb7c and is disjoint from its neighbours.
PUSH EDI; MOV ECX,ESI; CALL 0x007cd950 passes the controller in ECX and the animation id on the stack, after the vtable+0x04 call.
Body is a single store of argument 2 to argument 1 + 0x1c.
MOV EAX,[ESP+0x4]; MOV dword ptr [ECX+0x1c],EAX; RET 0x4 confirms the publication offset and the single-argument cleanup.
Five direct call sites, four in FUN_00577e10 and one in Editors::cEditor::AddCreature.
